# Where to Watch Inside Wingfeather


by Angel | September 16, 2026


*Inside Wingfeather* goes behind the scenes of *The Wingfeather Saga* , revealing the creativity, craftsmanship, and collaboration that bring Andrew Peterson’s world of Aerwiar to life. Through interviews with the storytellers, artists, animators, composers, and filmmakers behind the series, each short episode offers a closer look at what happens long before a finished scene reaches the screen.


[Stream Inside Wingfeather now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/inside-wingfeather)


### **From Page to Screen**


Adapting a beloved story is no small task. The world that readers imagine on the page has to become something audiences can see, hear, and experience.


*Inside Wingfeather* explores that process from the inside, following the many creative disciplines that come together to build the animated world of Aerwiar. Artists develop the look of the characters and environments. Animators bring them to life. Composers create the music that shapes the emotional landscape. Storytellers and filmmakers work across all of it to make the pieces fit together.


The result is a behind-the-scenes look at just how much work goes into creating an animated series.


### **Meet the Team Behind Aerwiar**


*Inside Wingfeather* introduces the people responsible for bringing it to the screen, giving audiences a closer look at the artists, animators, composers, and storytellers behind the series. Their interviews reveal not only what they do, but why they care so deeply about the work.


That personal perspective is part of what makes the series feel different from a traditional making-of feature. It’s not simply a look at finished animation. It’s a look at the people, ideas, and creative decisions behind it.


### **Inspiring the Next Generation of Storytellers**


There’s another side to going behind the scenes: seeing how stories are made can make the creative process feel possible.


By showing the people and work behind *The Wingfeather Saga* , *Inside Wingfeather* offers a glimpse into the many paths that can lead from an idea to a finished story. One Angel Guild member reflected on that potential, saying the series could stir kids’ imaginations and “hopefully inspire another generation.”


For aspiring writers, artists, musicians, animators, and filmmakers, seeing that process can be just as meaningful as watching the finished series.


### **A Deeper Look at** ***The Wingfeather Saga***


For fans of *The Wingfeather Saga* , *Inside Wingfeather* adds another layer to the experience. Instead of simply returning to Aerwiar, viewers get to see how that world was imagined, designed, scored, animated, and brought together by a team of passionate storytellers.


It’s a celebration of the work that happens behind the scenes—and a reminder that every finished frame represents countless creative decisions.


### **Watch** ***Inside Wingfeather*** **on Angel**


Whether it’s a sketchbook, recording session, animation frame, musical score, or conversation with the people behind the production, *Inside Wingfeather* reveals the artistry that audiences don’t always get to see.


For anyone who has ever wondered how a beloved story makes the leap from page to screen, *Inside Wingfeather* opens the door with each inspiring episode.
